# M3-10b: Slack questions

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-10b`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-10b`
- Depends on: M3-10a
- Touches (exclusive while running): slack/
- Plan refs: §5, §2 `questions`, R9b, spikes/slack.md §Payload shapes, BACKLOG Plan questions 2
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
Finbot asks in Slack with buttons, applies the first valid answer exactly once, and closes questions that no longer matter.

## Scope
- Render Block Kit: payee, amount, date, account; top-3 buttons; "other…"; "split". Payee and memo are shown as plain text so they can't inject mrkdwn or mentions.
- Button `value` carries only the local question id and option index. Category ids stay in `questions.options`, and the click payload is never trusted for them.
- Route clicks and thread replies through `questions.(channel_id, message_ts)`. `ClaimAnswer` decides the winner; the loser's click is a no-op.
- "other…" swaps in a `static_select` of the question's candidates.
- "split": the message says to split in YNAB, and the question closes with reason `split_in_ynab` (default for Plan question 2).
- Thread replies: an exact category-name match answers the question; anything else gets a one-line pointer to the buttons. No LLM in M3.
- Answers by kind, decided from the stored row and never from the click payload:
  - `dry_run_check`: recorded only. **`Applier` is never called**, whatever the current mode. The message says YNAB wasn't changed.
  - `categorize`: an injected `Applier` runs the answer. On `ErrDryRun` or `ErrBeforeAutoSince` the answer is recorded and the message says YNAB wasn't changed.
- `chat.update` shows the result and who answered.
- `CloseStale`: called after sync; closes open questions whose transaction is now locked, deleted or categorized, and updates each message.

## Out of scope
- Deciding what to ask (M3-11). Modals, split amounts, free text.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: button values contain no YNAB id.
- [ ] Test: a tampered option index is rejected.
- [ ] Test: two users click at once and `Applier` runs once.
- [ ] Test: routing works after a restart (reopened DB).
- [ ] Tests: "other…", "split", exact-name reply, non-matching reply.
- [ ] Test: a `dry_run_check` answer never calls `Applier`, even with a fake that would succeed (auto in effect); it's recorded and the message says YNAB wasn't changed.
- [ ] Test: a `categorize` answer that gets `ErrDryRun` is recorded with the same message.
- [ ] Test: a payee containing `<!channel>` or `*bold*` renders inert.
- [ ] Test: `CloseStale` closes locked and deleted cases only.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Supervisor note (from M3-10a review, agy low)
`slack/slack.go` `c.click` fills `Click.Value` from the action's `value`. A Block Kit `static_select` (the "other…" candidate dropdown) carries its choice in `selected_option.value` instead, so `Click.Value` is empty for it. Handle that here (read the selected option for select actions) and test it; this task may touch `slack/` for that fix.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `slack/questions.go` (new): `Questions` with `Ask` (post a pending question, mark it open), `HandleClick`, `HandleReply`,
    `CloseStale`, and `Handlers()` to wire into `Client`. Interfaces `QuestionStore` (*store.DB), `Applier` (*writer.Writer),
    `Messenger` (*Client). Close reasons `split_in_ynab`, `deleted`, `locked`.
  - Buttons and select options carry only `<question id>:<option index>` (`other`/`split` carry `<question id>`). Action ids
    `q_pick_0..2`, `q_other`, `q_split`, `q_select`. A choice is accepted only if the id matches the question routed by
    `(channel, message_ts)`, the index is canonical, in range and names a category option.
  - `questions.answer` stores the chosen category id. Kind comes from the stored row: `dry_run_check` only records;
    `categorize` calls `Applier.Apply` (Approve=true, actor = user label, via `slack`) after the claim is won.
  - `slack/slack.go`: supervisor note fixed (a `static_select` click's `Click.Value` = `selected_option.value`); new
    `Client.PostBlocks`/`UpdateBlocks` send escaped fallback text with `mrkdwn=false`.
  - Tests: `slack/questions_test.go` (real temp SQLite, fake Applier/Messenger), `TestSelectClickValue` in `slack_test.go`.
- Acceptance:
  - No YNAB id in button values → pass (`TestQuestionMessageCarriesNoYNABID`, checks whole payload incl. the select)
  - Tampered option index rejected → pass (`TestTamperedChoiceRejected`)
  - Two users click at once, Applier runs once → pass (`TestConcurrentClicksApplyOnce`, also under `-race`)
  - Routing after restart → pass (`TestRoutingAfterRestart`)
  - other… / split / exact-name reply / non-matching reply → pass (`TestOtherSwapsInSelect`, `TestSplitClosesQuestion`,
    `TestExactNameReplyAnswers`, `TestNonMatchingReplyGetsPointer`)
  - dry_run_check never calls Applier → pass (`TestDryRunCheckNeverApplies`, button and reply)
  - categorize + ErrDryRun recorded with "YNAB wasn't changed" → pass (`TestCategorizeGatedAnswerIsRecorded`, also ErrBeforeAutoSince)
  - `<!channel>` / `*bold*` payee inert → pass (`TestPayeeRendersInert`)
  - CloseStale closes locked and deleted only → pass (`TestCloseStaleClosesLockedAndDeletedOnly`)
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → pass; `go test -race ./slack` → pass
- Deviations from brief:
  - "categorized" in CloseStale is covered by the category lock: M3-9 locks a human's categorization (first_touch or
    ynab_edit). An unapproved row with YNAB's payee-memory guess has no lock and stays open, per the acceptance's "only".
    A question whose transaction is missing from the mirror closes as `deleted`.
  - Thread-reply match ignores case and surrounding space, unescapes Slack's `&amp;`/`&lt;`/`&gt;`, tries the question's
    candidates first, then the plan's visible categories; a name shared by two categories matches neither.
  - `DecidedCategoryID` for a Slack answer is the mirror's category just before Apply (questions don't store it); a human
    change after asking still stops the write through its lock.
  - `who` shows `<@id>` only for a well-formed Slack id, else the label.
- Follow-ups for backlog: M3-11 must call `Ask` for pending questions, wire `Questions.Handlers()` into the Client and call
  `CloseStale` after each sync (not wired here: `cmd/` is outside this task's scope). M3-16 can read `questions.answer` as a
  category id.
- Docs follow-ups: CLAUDE.md `slack/` role: questions (render, routing, `CloseStale`, answer = category id, close reasons).
